gist.summary: Added MebelSmetaBot to the README bot list and app catalog. The Telegram bot takes a phone photo of a kitchen or room and uses the Pollinations image API to visualize new furniture in that space.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art furniture workshop, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and looks at a phone with a Telegram paper-plane icon as a photo of a kitchen becomes a furnished visualization; code-plants grow beside the workbench against a prominent lime green (#ecf874), mint-to-peach pastel background. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, with consistent rounded proportions, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but emotionally warm.
